channel.title: ReLU.chat Blog
channel.description: Technical articles about on-device AI, browser-based chatbots, NLP, and privacy-first machine learning.

item.title: Measuring Retrieval Quality: Precision, Recall, MRR and NDCG
item.description: How to evaluate a knowledge-base retriever with precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG: definitions, worked examples, and a tuning loop for dense/sparse ensembles.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Chunking Strategies for Knowledge Bases: Splitting Text for Retrieval
item.description: How chunk size, boundaries, and overlap decide what a knowledge base retriever can find — fixed, overlapping, and structure-aware chunking compared.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Query Expansion Without an LLM: Synonyms, Spelling and Boosting
item.description: Improve retrieval without an LLM: index-time alias weighting, query-side synonym expansion, edit-distance spelling correction, and boosting before re-ranking.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: How Knowledge Bases Are Structured: Fragments, Fields and Metadata
item.description: Knowledge base entries built from categorized fragments, weighted fields, and confidence metadata — and why structure decides retrieval quality.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: IndexedDB for On-Device AI: Storing Embeddings and Session State Locally
item.description: Store embeddings as binary and session state as records with IndexedDB: schema design, vector search, transactions, and local-first privacy.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Float32 vs Float64: Precision Trade-Offs for In-Browser ML
item.description: When to use float32 versus float64 in browser ML: tensors stay float32, accumulators like EMA summaries deserve float64, and int8 quantization shrinks weights.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: The Real Cost of Cosine Similarity: Optimizing Vector Math in JavaScript
item.description: What cosine similarity actually costs in the browser, and how precomputed norms, typed arrays, bounded top-k, and memoization cut that cost.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Offline-First Chat Architecture: Queues, Retries and Sync-Free Design
item.description: Designing browser chat that works offline: persisted work queues, retries with backoff and idempotency, and sync-free design with one local copy of state.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Model Size vs Quality: Why a Small Distilled Model Can Beat a Big One on Edge Devices
item.description: Smaller can be better: distillation, quantization, and domain fit explain when a 22 MB model beats a much larger one on edge devices.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Conversation State Machines: Modes, Intents and Follow-Up Routing
item.description: How modes, intents, and follow-up routing fit together in a conversation state machine, with JavaScript examples and a look at ReLU.chat's policy.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Debugging In-Browser ML: Profiling, Logging and Graceful Fallbacks
item.description: Practical techniques for debugging browser-based ML: profiling inference stages, structured on-device logging, and graceful fallback paths.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Bias in Retrieval Chatbots: Where It Comes From and How to Audit It
item.description: Where bias enters retrieval chatbots — corpus, embeddings, term weighting, ranking — and a practical audit procedure for each stage.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Privacy Checklist for Browser-Based AI: What Actually Leaves Your Device
item.description: What actually leaves your device when AI runs in the browser? A six-step audit: network, offline test, storage, and source.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Named Entity Recognition Without an LLM: Regex, Fuzzy Matching, and Knowledge Bases
item.description: Gazetteers, regex, Levenshtein fuzzy matching, and knowledge bases deliver solid entity extraction in the browser — no LLM required.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: The Math of BM25: A Worked Example of Sparse Retrieval
item.description: Step-by-step BM25 ranking: smoothed IDF, term-frequency saturation (k1), length normalization (b), and field weighting.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: WebAssembly and On-Device ML: Why WASM Makes Browser AI Fast
item.description: What WebAssembly is, why compiled numeric kernels beat JavaScript for ML, and how runtimes like ONNX Runtime run models entirely in the browser.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Latency Budgets for Conversational UI: The 400ms Response Rule
item.description: First-token latency under 400 ms keeps a conversation feeling instant. Budgets, streaming, and progressive loading for conversational UI.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: KaTeX vs MathJax: Rendering Math in the Browser
item.description: KaTeX vs MathJax for in-browser math: speed, bundle size, TeX coverage, accessibility, and streaming chat output.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: INT8 Quantization Explained: From FP32 to 8-Bit Without Losing Accuracy
item.description: How INT8 quantization maps FP32 weights and activations to 256 buckets, why accuracy usually survives, and how calibration keeps it that way.
item.author: ReLU.chat

item.title: Cosine Similarity and Vector Search: The Math Behind Semantic Retrieval
item.description: The math of cosine similarity and vector search: dot products, normalization, brute-force top-k in the browser, and hybrid dense-sparse ranking.
item.author: ReLU.chat
